candidate.title: Scrape ANY Website in Seconds for Your LLMs
candidate.description:
One of the biggest challenges we face with LLMs right now is their knowledge is too general and limited for anything new because of their “training cutoffs”. That’s why RAG is such a huge topic when it comes to AI right now - it’s a method for providing an LLM with external knowledge you curate so it can become an expert at something it wasn’t before - a specific AI framework, your ecommerce store, you name it. The problem is, that “curate” step can be very difficult and slow! If you want to feed an entire website into the knowledgebase for an LLM, for example, how do you actually do that and get it done fast?

That is where Crawl4AI comes in! Crawl4AI is an open source web crawling framework specifically designed for scraping websites and formatting the output in the BEST possible way for an LLM to understand. The best part is it solves a LOT of problems we typically have with systems that crawl websites - usually they are slow, resource intensive, and complicated. But Crawl4AI is VERY fast, intuitive, easy to set up, and extremely memory efficient.
